briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race ahead as multi-agent systems expose new security gaps

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has intensified with frontier labs releasing iterative models focused on agentic workflows. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny grows over autonomous systems. Prompt injection and multi-agent coordination remain central risks.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with enhanced reasoning chains; Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus emphasizing constitutional safety; Google DeepMind launched Gemini 3 with native tool use; Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B; xAI pushed Grok-3 updates; DeepSeek announced V3.5. Multi-agent orchestration is the dominant capability leap.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. New attacks on agent swarms reported across enterprise deployments. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA shipped 1.2M Blackwell GPUs this quarter; Microsoft announced $15B Stargate cluster expansion; TSMC ramped 2nm AI chip production; Saudi Arabia broke ground on a 200MW sovereign AI data center.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first self-improving agent cluster cross the autonomy threshold before 2027 safety standards are ratified?
